guard/30198.htm.text: Guard Jerin: Eh, nice weather, eh stranger? I've been a guard for a long time but, honestly, I've never even gotten a scratch in the line of duty. I am lucky. Really, even though you're a skilled adventurer, you'll never be able to beat someone who's lucky. One of my friends... He was so drunk one …

links.text: Ask about the Sea of Spores.
Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30198-1.htm.text: Guard Jerin: the mages of the Ivory Tower joined with the Elves to build the Protection Tower at the center of the Sea of Spores. It was supposedly erected to halt the spread of the Sea of Spores but there is no evidence it is working... I think it more likely they are up to something...

guard/30198-2.htm.text: Guard Jerin: You will see strange towers northwest of the town. Past the towers you will find the Sea of Spores. Fungus, mushrooms and other unusual plants grow there...
